review_scope: AI bilingual source review; source identity and protected spans checked separately; not runtime/maintainer acceptance

description.source: Create or update the project constitution from interactive or provided principle inputs.
description.zh_CN: 根据交互输入或已提供的原则，创建或更新项目宪法。

argument-hint.source: Principles or values for the project constitution
argument-hint.zh_CN: 项目宪法的原则或价值观

description.source: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language feature description.
description.zh_CN: 根据自然语言功能描述，创建或更新功能规格。

argument-hint.source: Describe the feature you want to define

description.source: Identify underspecified areas in the current feature spec by asking up to 5 highly targeted clarification questions and encoding answers back into the spec.
description.zh_CN: 针对当前功能规格中说明不足的部分，提出最多 5 个高度聚焦的澄清问题，并将答案写回规格。

argument-hint.source: Optional areas to clarify in the spec
argument-hint.zh_CN: 可选：需要澄清的规格部分

description.source: Execute the implementation planning workflow using the plan template to generate design artifacts.
description.zh_CN: 使用方案模板执行实施规划流程，生成设计产物。

argument-hint.source: Optional guidance for the planning phase
argument-hint.zh_CN: 可选：规划阶段的补充指导

description.source: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md for the feature based on available design artifacts.
description.zh_CN: 根据已有设计产物，生成可执行且按依赖排序的 tasks.md。

description.source: Perform a non-destructive cross-artifact consistency and quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md after task generation.
description.zh_CN: 在任务生成后，对 spec.md、plan.md 和 tasks.md 进行非破坏性的跨产物一致性与质量分析。

description.source: Generate a custom checklist for the current feature based on user requirements.
description.zh_CN: 根据用户需求，为当前功能生成定制的需求质量核对清单。

argument-hint.source: Domain or focus area for the checklist

description.source: Execute the implementation plan by processing and executing all tasks defined in tasks.md
description.zh_CN: 执行实施计划，处理并完成 tasks.md 中定义的所有任务。

argument-hint.source: Optional implementation guidance or task filter
argument-hint.zh_CN: 可选：实施指导或任务筛选

description.source: Assess the current codebase against the feature's spec, plan, and tasks, then append any remaining unbuilt work as new tasks to tasks.md so implement can complete it.
description.zh_CN: 将实际实现与需求、方案及任务进行比较，识别剩余差距，并将修正任务追加到任务清单。

output-language.reviewer: approved presentation scope; AI text review

status.reviewer: AI contract review: local STATUS specification; not user authentication
